My interests, concerns and initiatives have fluctuated over time — some have been more occasional, others more constant. Still, I think I can recognize a few patterns that show up more permanently: a focus on structural improvement that defines us socially from collectivity, a willingness to collaborate with initiatives rooted in the local community, a formal and practical interest in health and lifestyles, and an understanding of individual perspectives and feelings, useful for building a robust, conscious empathy.
